description: When we look at public projects today, we are used to a short-sighted cycle. Roads need patching every few years, equipment wears out, and taxpayers are constantly asked to foot the bill to replace things that broke. But what if we built infrastructure meant to last centuries instead of decades? R

title: Building for the Next Millennium: A Common-Sense Energy Blueprint for Our Community — Ian G Richardson for Indiana HD79
